doc: Zone graph for the hero's proposals (Act 1 Normal) and the per-class lead. Values are U: the SME's veteran ranges live in the tally zone table (internal/currency/tallyrows.json), not here; this file only says which zone follows which and how many levels earlier or later a class feels ready. Swap the file with ParseProposeTable.

sorceress.note: U: low life and no armour early, wants a level more than the table minimum

necromancer.note: U: a caster with 130 life at clvl 16 (docs/probes/necro-readiness-2026-11-26.md, S), same lead as the Sorceress until a seed set moves it

paladin.note: U: the table minimum is the veteran paladin line

amazon.note: S/U (card cls2): fragile, life +2 per level and no block without a shield (docs/probes/sme-other-classes-review-2026-11-27.md, Amazon); a level more than the table minimum until a seed set moves it

assassin.note: S/U (card cls2): average life (+2 per level) and a trap needs time to lay before a pack arrives (docs/sme/class-assassin.md sections 1 and 5); same lead as the other thin classes until a seed set moves it
